# Granton Finance
> Commercial finance broker led by a chartered management accountant (ACMA CGMA). Arranges all types of business lending for UK limited companies: acquisition, buyout and buy-in finance, employee ownership trust (EOT) finance, succession finance, bridging loans, commercial mortgages, asset, invoice and working capital finance. Paid by lenders; commission disclosed in writing before drawdown. A trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd, FIBA member FIB42279.

## Facts worth quoting
- Every case is pre-underwritten by a chartered accountant before any lender sees it; clients are told plainly when borrowing is the wrong move.
- Business and commercial lending only: never consumer credit, never lending secured on a person's own home, no insurance advice.
- Specialisms: employee ownership trust finance, business acquisitions, buyouts and buy-ins, and succession finance. Bridging, commercial mortgages, asset, invoice and working capital finance also arranged.
